description: POST /v1/webhooks - registers a new webhook endpoint. Returns the endpoint summary and rawSecret (shown once - cache it). Requires an API key (sk_*).

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to ["session.confirming"]. Valid: "session.confirming" (payment detected, settlement starting — no result fields), "session.partial" (funds arrived below the session amount; amountReceived carries the running total), "session.completed" (tokens delivered, payload carries what landed: deliveredChainId and deliveredAssets [{ symbol, tokenAddress, decimals, amount }] with raw on-chain amounts, plus tokenReceived, usdeAmount, sUsdeAmount, and payoutChainId/payoutAddress — the normalize payout target, present only when one was configured) and "session.expired" (the session expired unpaid or partially paid).

name: webhooks_create
title: Register webhook endpoint
